d:
Prashant Kishor Exclusive Interview men PK ne tejasvi yadav ke dave par javab diya aur mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri par tikha hamla bola. JDU ko amit shah chalane se lekar bijepi men vilay ki sanbhavna tak, prashant kishor ne bihar ki rajniti par kaee bare bayan die. dekhie prashant kishor ka pura Exclusive Interview sirph Bihar Tak par.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
